items: 【The Only Purses You'll Ever Need】 Our LOVEVOOK handbags serves as a shoulder bag, handbag, tote, and crossbody bag all in one. It's a multi-purpose accessory that transitions seamlessly from work to weekend.

items.label: 【Sized for Real Life】 Dimensions
items.value: 12.6*4.5*9 inches, the handle height of 7 inch.The adjustable shoulder strap can be extended up to 24.8 inches is perfect for carrying or slinging over your shoulder.

items: 【Quality You Can Feel】 Made from High-Quality PU Leather, our bags are not only fashionable but also durable.
【Details That Make a Difference】 Utility doesn't sacrifice style. Our bags come with unique ornaments and a long removable shoulder strap, offering versatility and a touch of elegant lady charm.
【Room for Everything】 1 external rear zippered pocket, 2 large compartment pockets, 2 internal zippered pockets, and 2 slip pockets, providing ample space to organize all your essentials.
【Just the Right Fit for Your Day 】 Our bag comfortably holds your daily essentials like phones, cosmetics, and even a water bottle.

items.label: Material Features
items.value: High-quality vintage Faux leather with a smooth texture and eco-friendly properties

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Clean with a damp cloth. Avoid water exposure.
